title: Basil field
summary: Mature basil on 40 in raised beds, laid out from the September 2026 survey of the western field. Closed hedges, paired furrows, real field around it.
yield_source: One reported harvest: 82,760 lb from 13.54 acres, top 10 in cut (6,112 lb/acre). Labels are synthetic.
label_notice: Synthetic labels: the reported aggregate per area is distributed over clumps by height. Not field measurements.
far_field: Original-photo RGB mosaic of the western field, 2026-09-26 (before harvest) and 2026-09-27 (after).
